cases.name: two-hop-chain
cases.purpose: The ordinary case. From one seed, hop 1 is its importer, its import and its test; hop 2 is the import's import. An implementation that walks edges in one direction only will miss the importer and the test.

cases.name: spelling-tolerance
cases.purpose: Two seeds spelled the way callers actually hold them: a leading ./ and a Windows separator. Both must normalize onto the same paths the graph is keyed by. An implementation that joins on the raw string finds nothing and reports an empty neighbourhood, which is the silent failure this contract exists to remove.

cases.name: isolated-file
cases.purpose: A file that is present in the snapshot and has no edges. The seed is in the snapshot and the neighbourhood is empty; those are two different facts and both are reported.

cases.name: seed-outside-snapshot
cases.purpose: A path the snapshot has never seen. It is reported as not in the snapshot, NOT as a file with no neighbours. A consumer that collapses those two states is asserting something intel did not say.

seedsRejected.reason: Path is not a portable repository-relative path: ""
Path escapes or is not canonical: "../outside.ts"
Path is not a portable repository-relative path: "/etc/passwd"

cases.name: unusable-seeds
cases.purpose: Seeds that are not repository-relative portable paths: absolute, escaping, and empty. Each is rejected with a reason and none of them aborts the walk for the seeds that are usable.

cases.name: hop-bound-zero
cases.purpose: maxHops 0 returns the seeds and nothing else. The walk is bounded by what was asked.

cases.name: file-bound-truncation
cases.purpose: maxFiles 1 admits one file and stops, and says it stopped. Which file is admitted is decided by code-unit order, so the prefix is the same on every machine — under locale collation it is not.

consumerConvention.note: `consumerConventionEcho.proximity` is decay^hop for the constants named here, and it is ARITHMETIC, not a recommendation. Intel emits hop counts; a weighting is a consumer's judgement and its constants belong in the consumer's own source where a reviewer can see them in the consumer's diff. The echo is here only so two independent implementations of one consumer-side convention cannot disagree about the multiplication.
